business_summary.text: Post-merger Indiabulls Limited operates real estate development (owned and JV residential and commercial projects, mainly Delhi NCR and Mumbai) alongside stock broking, asset reconstruction, an SMB lending platform and equipment leasing.

call_points.text: FY26 operations: 21.6 lakh sqft sold, 909 units, ₹2,752 Cr sales booked and ₹400 Cr collected.
Broking revenue fell 5% to ₹124 Cr in FY26 from ₹131 Cr, though Q4FY26 rose 26% YoY to ₹34 Cr.
Broking scale: 1.73 lakh demat accounts, 1,12,422 active accounts and ₹68k Cr client assets.
SMB platform Spring Cash LLC has 150+ US businesses onboarded and $102M funded; India rollout planned with the NBFC ecosystem.

operating_notes.text: FY26 sales booked of ₹2,752 Cr against collections of ₹400 Cr, with ₹2,493 Cr of booked sales still to be recognised as revenue.
Total GDV of ₹21,366 Cr over 110.52 lakh sqft: ₹3,393 Cr launched in FY26, ₹6,029 Cr FY27 launches and ₹11,944 Cr future pipeline.
ARC fee-paying AUM ₹622 Cr, assets under collection ₹3,794 Cr, FY26 recoveries ₹288 Cr and capital adequacy 97.92%.

timeline.summary: Indiabulls Limited (formerly Yaari Digital Integrated Services) reported FY26 revenue of ₹880.7 Cr and PAT of ₹346.1 Cr in its first post-merger investor presentation, with a ₹21,366 Cr GDV real estate pipeline.
